instruction: Open "cola.png" in GIMP via command line and crop 10% from both the top and bottom edges, then export as "cropped.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires cropping 10% from top and bottom of cola.png (1233x1280). Expected result: 1233x1024. Verified: 1280 * (1 - 0.1 - 0.1) = 1024 pixels height.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the crop operation by checking final image dimensions
Expected dimensions (1233x1024) are mathematically correct: original 1233x1280 cropped by 10% top (128px) and 10% bottom (128px) = 1024px height
Getter logic correctly extracts image dimensions from the exported file using PIL
Metric logic correctly compares actual vs expected dimensions with appropriate tolerance (2 pixels)
Complete coverage: verifies file exists, exported correctly, and has correct dimensions proving crop was performed
No postconfig needed as verification is file-based (not UI-based)
Data flow is semantically correct: file download -> dimension extraction -> comparison with calculated expected values
